title: Efficiency: KEY_GET_INFO trial export allocates and runs full key_export_public to get key length
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c ioctl_key_get_info() — allocates CRYPTO2DEV_PUBKEY_MAXLEN (256 bytes), calls key_export_public() in full (encoding work for RSA/EC), then memzero_explicit+kfree — all just to populate one u32 public_key_len field. Cost per call: 256-byte kmalloc + full key serialization + memzero. Matters at scale if callers poll KEY_GET_INFO (monitoring loops, test harnesses). Fix requires a new key_size() ops callback that returns the encoded length without allocating, but that is an API change.
